tests.description: Reference: WRF 4.8 em_scm_xy COLD-SEASON single-column run, data/eqwefic/noahcold_scm, dumped by ctessum-claude/WRF branch earthsciml-instrumented-noahcold and replayed through the real64 (-fdefault-real-8) kernels/noah_driver at ESM_DT = 1e-6 s. `z0` is asserted against the Registry variable `z0_out`, which the driver already dumps -- SNOWZ0 needed no instrumentation, and the component reproduces it BITWISE at all 84 steps of the set, so `z0` is asserted at ZERO TOLERANCE rather than at the project's 1e-9 -- the same choice `frozen_soil.esm` made once its publisher removed the last cancelling difference. There is nothing here for a tolerance to absorb: the routine is four arithmetic operations on values the dump carries exactly. THE REPLAY PASS IS NOT CHOSEN FOR ACCURACY, because this routine has none of the step dependence that decided it for the two components next door: four lines of algebra on the current state, no dt in them and nothing differenced, so no pass is more precise than another (FORTRAN_BUGS N99's rule has nothing to bite on here, which is itself worth saying). It is chosen because it is the pass where the snow-cover input is unambiguous: at the 60 s pass, case D step 553's pack vanishes DURING the step and SNOPAC zeroes `sncovr` afterwards, so the dumped cover is no longer the one SNFRAC handed SNOWZ0 earlier in the same call. It is also the pass `snow_cover.esm` -- which supplies that input in an assembly -- is referenced against. TWO INPUTS ARE NOT THE OBVIOUS ONES. `z0brd` is REDPRM's greenness-selected value (`z0brd_out`), not the argument SFLX is passed: FORTRAN_BUGS N96, extended here to a fourth quantity, and live in this set -- the dumped argument takes 0.05 at some steps while the value the routine uses is 0.150000006 at every one. `snowh` is the CURRENT post-SNOW_NEW depth, not the previous step's that SFLX's comment above the call claims; the previous depth reproduces WRF to only 7.1e-12 relative against bitwise agreement with the current one. Step 1 of case A, snow falling onto initially bare frozen ground: NO SNOW COVER: the cover-weighted average degenerates to z0brd exactly, which is what SFLX's own `ELSE Z0 = Z0BRD` branch does, so this step tests that the guard is an optimisation and not a semantic branch on this path.
